يتواءم (form VI)
# يَتَوَاءَمُ (yatawāʔamu) /ja.ta.waː.ʔa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# يَتَوَاءَمَ (yatawāʔama) /ja.ta.waː.ʔa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# يَتَوَاءَمْ (yatawāʔam) /ja.ta.waː.ʔam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
